source_pattern: Pattern 1: Recurring gap: Cold-start coverage completeness
behavior_change: Recipe currently activates modules without verifying that rules/cold-start.md exists for each selected module; it should emit MISSING_COLD_START and refuse to complete module selection when any selected module lacks that file.
risk: Recipe currently never fails on missing cold-start files, so the new check will produce false positives for any module legitimately excluded from cold-start scope. Modules in L8 Experiment group or third-party plugins that intentionally omit cold-start.md would be blocked from activation until their status is clarified.
rollback_condition: Rollback if MISSING_COLD_START fires on more than 5% of module activations in the first 20 real task sessions, indicating the cold-start file requirement is not yet universally met and the gate is too strict for current corpus completeness.
